# BhoomiMitra (भू-मित्र) - Property Marketplace Across India (Full Specification)

> BhoomiMitra is an India-focused property marketplace connecting listed sellers with prospective buyers and tenants. Sellers may be individuals, companies, or agents. The marketplace supports properties offered for sale, rent, or lease.

BhoomiMitra currently charges no platform listing fee and does not take a brokerage percentage or success fee from a property transaction. Property information is supplied by sellers. Platform review does not constitute legal, title, ownership, valuation, approval, or survey verification.

Supported property groups include land and plots, residential property, commercial and industrial property, and hospitality property. Buyers and tenants can use structured search and location filters and contact the listed seller directly.

Indian Land Measurement Conversions:
- 1 Square Yard = 1 sq. yd (9 sq. ft)
- 1 Gunta = 121 sq. yds
- 1 Cent = 48.4 sq. yds
- 1 Acre = 4,840 sq. yds (40 Guntas / 100 Cents)
- 1 Hectare = 11,959.9 sq. yds (2.471 Acres)
- Bigha varies by region and should not be treated as a single national conversion.

## Key Public Routes

- [Marketplace Homepage](https://bhoomimitra.com/): Property discovery, search, and featured listings.
- [Find Property](https://bhoomimitra.com/buy): Search sale, rent, and lease listings by property type, location, area, price, and related filters.
- [Post Property](https://bhoomimitra.com/sell): Create or edit a listing and submit it for the applicable platform review workflow.
- [About BhoomiMitra](https://bhoomimitra.com/about): Marketplace model and platform information.
- [Customer Support](https://bhoomimitra.com/contact): Customer support and grievance contact.
- [Listing Rules](https://bhoomimitra.com/listing-rules): Seller requirements, content standards, and prohibited listings.
- [Terms of Service](https://bhoomimitra.com/terms): Platform terms, seller responsibilities, buyer due diligence, and liability limitations.
- [Privacy Policy](https://bhoomimitra.com/privacy): Account, listing, private-document, and service-data practices.
- [Refund and Cancellation Policy](https://bhoomimitra.com/refund-policy): Current policy for marketplace services.

## Marketplace Workflow

1. A seller signs in and completes required account verification.
2. The seller creates a draft with property, location, pricing, media, and seller information.
3. The seller submits the listing for the applicable platform review workflow.
4. An approved listing can become publicly visible as PUBLISHED.
5. The seller can manage, pause, edit, mark sold, or delete the listing through supported dashboard actions.

## Seller Types

- Individual
- Company
- Agent

Seller type identifies how the advertiser is acting. It is not a BhoomiMitra guarantee of ownership or legal authority.

## Buyer and Tenant Safety

BhoomiMitra does not guarantee ownership, title, boundaries, measurements, encumbrances, approvals, land-use status, litigation status, valuation, or document authenticity. Users should independently verify the property with appropriate legal, registration, revenue, survey, planning, and other authorities before making a payment or commitment.

## Private Documents

Optional seller-uploaded supporting documents are intended for authorized workflows and are not part of the public listing payload. Public marketplace users should rely on independent verification rather than treating platform document review as a title guarantee.

## Tools

- Land area conversion for commonly used Indian land units.
- Property search and filters.
- Seller dashboard and listing management.
- Buyer inquiries and direct listed-seller contact.
- Reporting and moderation workflows.
